title: Lipschitz solutions to mean field games with a major player and applications
summary: This paper introduces a notion of weak solution for the coupled system of master equations in mean field games with a major player. It extends the previously introduced notion of Lipschitz solutions in mean field games. By relying on a probabilistic representation of the system of master equations, we prove that there can exist at most one sufficiently smooth solution and that it is consistent with the associated Nash equilibrium.
